_comment: Written by the trading runs (9:30a / hourly / 3:30p ET). Never contains account numbers, broker IDs, or any account other than the sandbox.

account.note: Cash account. Proceeds settle T+1. The account figure is the broker's, struck on the 0.51 option mark; on the 0.50 bid the position is worth 100.00 and the account 111.98. Deployable is 11.98 and that is the operative number - it buys no contract and one share of only the cheapest names on the list, so a second position is arithmetically closed off rather than declined.

positions.desc: 2 contracts @ 0.57 · long call · opened 10:46 ET by the operator
positions.noFly: None. Re-verified on the broker calendar at 11:23 ET: SMR does not appear anywhere in the 8/6–8/15 window, so no print lands before the 8/14 expiry.
positions.note: No level hit at 11:23. Target 0.684 is 36.8% above the 0.50 bid, the 0.342 stop is 31.6% below it, and the time stop is session one of five. What moved this hour was decay, not direction: SMR is 9.39 bid against the 9.445 it was bought at, down 0.6%, while the contract went 0.545 mark to 0.51 and the position to -12.3%. Theta is -0.0344 a day, 6.8% of mark, so roughly two thirds of the loss so far is the clock rather than the underlying. Delta has slipped 0.517 to 0.5007 and break-even is 10.01, which needs SMR up 6.6% from here. The one thing that improved is the spread: 3.9% of mark against 9.2% at entry, on 318 contracts traded against 791 open interest. The dated item the pre-close run owns is the expiry, not a level — 8/14 is 8 days out today and 7 tomorrow, so the contract enters the final week docs/RULES.md says never to hold into.

entryWatch.trigger: Expired unexecuted at 10:35 ET — no equity order was ever placed against it
entryWatch.why: Fully resolved and left dead. The 09:47 specification's window ran out at 10:35 with no equity order of any state against it, and at 10:46 the operator opened 2 SMR 8/14 9.50 calls instead — the name from this board, the instrument from the operator. The 11:21 hourly adds the part the earlier runs could not yet see: the structural line the thesis rested on has broken. That line was the 9.505 8/5 high, and SMR is 9.39 bid, below it, having been 9.54 at 10:22 and 9.445 when the calls were bought. On the equity terms originally written this would now be a setup that failed rather than one that faded, which is worth recording precisely because the entry never filled — the specification's own level, 9.75, was never reachable after 10:22 and the thing that decided it was the 9.505 break, exactly as the 10:22 run said it would be. The option position carries its own levels and is tracked above; nothing about this dead equity setup revives, and no run should read the held calls as permission to add the shares underneath them.

entryWatch.trigger: Met and expired — held above 8.20, ran to +9.1%, has since faded back under the +8% line
entryWatch.why: Stays dead, and this hour is the one where that had to be re-argued rather than inherited. JOBY is 8.40 bid, +7.7% on the day, down from the 8.51 and +9.1% that disqualified it at 10:22 — so the single number item 2 names has slipped back under 8% and a run looking for a reason could call the objection expired. It is not, for two reasons that do not depend on the day's percentage. First, item 2 is about buying the reaction bar, and a name +7.7% having printed +9.1% intraday is still the reaction day; the rulebook wants the day-2/3 pullback, and day 2 is tomorrow. Second, and decisively at this account size, one share is all 11.98 of deployable cash would nearly buy at 8.41, and an -8% stop on it is 0.67 of room in a name that has already travelled 0.71 between its high and its current bid today. That is the identical stop-inside-the-noise objection that killed IONQ, and it is a property of the account against the name rather than a condition waiting to clear. Recorded because a disqualifier that lapses on a technicality is exactly how a chase gets written up as a setup.

entryWatch.trigger: Met — reclaimed the 41.37 opening print — but the disqualifier was never the trigger
entryWatch.why: Unchanged and unrevivable. IONQ is 41.22 bid, +3.2%, having faded from 41.57 at 10:22, so it is holding the reclaim of its 41.37 open only marginally. The trigger printing was never the question. At 41.22 a share the account cannot buy even one against 11.98 deployable, which has turned a stop-sits-inside-the-noise objection into a plain affordability one — the position size that made the -8% stop unusable is no longer reachable at all. Dead twice over.

entryWatch.trigger: None — the reclaim extended and does not revive it
entryWatch.why: Dead on structure, and the structure has not changed while the tape has. UPST is 30.81 bid, +2.0%, the strongest mover on the board this hour, up from 30.35 at 10:22 and now well clear of both the 30.20 close and the 30.32 pre-earnings line. Three hours of watching it reclaim more of the gap does not answer what killed it: 8/5 opened 34.595 and closed 30.20 on 12.3M shares against a 5.1M average, giving back the entire earnings move. A name working back up through a level it distributed through is not the pullback-after-strength the setup list wants, and the fact that it is now the best performer of the ones refused is the cost of that rule being written in advance rather than after the fact.

entryWatch.trigger: None available — item 2 forbids buying the +20% reaction bar
entryWatch.why: Dead, and still the clearest-paying refusal on the board. SOUN gapped from a 6.43 close to an 8.045 open, about +25%, and item 2 forbade it outright. It is 7.26 bid now: -9.8% from that open, having been -4.3% at 09:47 and -9.0% at 10:22. It has bled in every hour of the session while breadth went from 5 green of 12 to 9. Still +12.9% on the day, which is the whole point of tracking it — the daily change stays green while anyone who bought the open is down nearly 10% by lunchtime.

candidatesAsOf: 2026-08-06 11:23 ET, live session bids re-read by the mid-session run. The Last column is the official 8/5 settled close.
candidatesNote: Bids are live and quoted as bids, never marks. The account holds one position — the operator's 2 SMR 8/14 9.50 calls — and 11.98 of deployable settled cash, which closes off a second entry by arithmetic before any thesis is needed. Breadth has widened again, 5 of 12 green at 09:47, 8 at 10:22, 9 now, and the hour's honest observation is that the name this board picked is the one not participating: SMR is +0.1% and has now lost the 9.505 8/5 high its thesis rested on, while the three printers it was chosen over are +7.7%, +3.2% and +12.9%, and UPST — refused on structure — put in the best hour on the board at +2.0%. The runner-up outperforming the pick for a third consecutive hour is a fact about this decision, not a rule change; the rules that refused JOBY, IONQ and UPST were written before the prices were known and are re-argued rather than inherited in the entryWatch notes above. MARA and RGTI report tonight and OKLO reports 8/7 before the open, all verified on the broker calendar, so all three stay no-fly for any five-session hold. SMCI reports 8/11 after the close, session four of a hold opened today. QBTS already reported this morning and its miss is behind it.

candidates.note: Held, as 2 8/14 9.50 calls rather than the shares this board specified. Bid 9.39, +0.1%, down from 9.54 at 10:22 and 9.445 when the calls filled. It has lost the 9.505 8/5 high the thesis rested on, which the 10:22 run named as the level that decides this — below it the reversal is broken rather than fading. The contract's own levels are intact and none is hit; it is the underlying that has gone quiet, and a call financed by theta cannot afford quiet.

Bid 8.40, +7.7%, off the 8.51 high that made it +9.1% at 10:22. Still the best of last night's printers. Now technically back under the +8% line item 2 draws, and still refused: it is the reaction day rather than the day-2/3 pullback, and at one share an -8% stop is 0.67 of room against a 0.71 intraday travel — a stop inside the noise is not a stop.

Bid 41.22, +3.2%, fading from 41.57 and now only marginally above the 41.37 open it reclaimed. Academic now rather than merely ill-sized: at 41.22 a share the account cannot buy one against 11.98 deployable.
Bid 7.26, +12.9% on the day but -9.8% from the 8.045 open, having been -4.3% at 09:47 and -9.0% at 10:22. Has fallen in every hour of a session in which breadth widened to 9 of 12 green.

Bid 30.81, +2.0%, up from 30.35 at 10:22 and the strongest hour on the board. Extending the reclaim above the 30.32 line does not revive it: 8/5 gave back the entire gap on 12.3M shares against a 5.1M average, and working back up through a level you distributed through is not a pullback after strength.
Bid 490.72, +1.8%, holding the turn it made this morning from -0.7% at 09:47. Academic — one share is forty times deployable cash.

Bid 181.45, -3.3%, the worst on the board and still sliding — +1.1% at 09:47, -1.4% at 10:22. The 73% beat is being sold two sessions running, which is the expectations-versus-positioning pattern item 5 describes. Unreachable at this account size either way.

Bid 20.45, -4.4%, flat through the hour after missing at -0.13 against -0.10 this morning. Its print is now behind it, so it is no longer no-fly, but a miss is not a catalyst and one share is nearly twice deployable cash.
Reports tonight, re-verified on the broker calendar at 11:23 ET against a -0.05 estimate. Not held. Bid 16.90, +0.7%, easing from 17.08. Drift into a print is not a reason to own it into the print.

Reports tonight, re-verified on the broker calendar at 11:23 ET against a -0.33 estimate. Not held. Bid 11.13, -1.0%, unchanged through the hour. No catalyst before the print and no position to decide about.
